title: IMP — Corpus of Slovene Historical Texts, 1567-1899
notes: IMP is the diachronic corpus of historical Slovene (1567-1899, TEI P5, msd-annotated) integrated from nine sub-corpora incl. the ZRC SAZU digitisation of old Slovenian printings (DACP); the harvested files ('CLARIN.SI IMP ZRC_00001-1584-ana.xml: Dalmatin, Jurij (1584)', 'CLARIN.SI IMP ZRC_00002-1695-ana.xml: Janez Svetokriški (1695)') are the -ana (analytic/annotation) TEI files of the IMP distribution hosted on CLARIN.SI (hdl 11356/1255, also a texts-only version hdl 11356/1423). Licence: CLARIN.SI terms, varying per subcorpus. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Jozef Stefan Institute (CLARIN.SI) with ZRC SAZU Institute of Slovene Literature / Fran Ramovs Library and NUK
